authority: This Revision 13 registry, the Revision 13 design, and the Revision 13 plan are the only batch contracts.

active_attempt_stage.description: The stage currently owned by an in-flight attempt; it is independent from result_stage, which identifies the latest committed result.

reservation_id.description: Opaque public reservation identifier; never a workspace path.

allocation_id.description: Server-owned durable allocation operation ID; replaying it is idempotent.

provider_request_id.description: Required placeholder form unknown:<attempt_id> when no provider request id exists; cache_hit uses cache:<cache_key>.

reservation_id.description: Opaque public reservation identifier; never a workspace path.

last_error_message.description: Sanitized user-facing message; must not contain workspace paths, reservation internals, provider secrets or raw exception text.

api.session: ephemeral csrf/origin session; never authoritative for batch ownership
api.restart_rule: same workspace marker owner may claim after process restart only when no unexpired lease exists; claim increments claim_generation and revokes active owner_instance control
api.route_schema_policy: request_ref and response_ref must resolve to root schemas; route/error registry entries use symbolic error_ref=error, which resolves to the wire schema awake.worldbook.batch-error.v2

formulas.cache_materialization: Shared cache stores provider result payload only; each batch rebinds evidence and writes new result/evidence sidecars.
formulas.consent_binding_hash: SHA-256(CanonicalJson({authorized_item_ids:sort, batch_id, claim_generation, model_parameters, owner_id, provider_fingerprint, scope, selected_snapshot_bindings:sort-by-canonical-bytes([{snapshot_id,snapshot_hash}]), send_scope, workspace_marker_hash}))
formulas.consent_cas: start uses consent revision + state=issued CAS; for metadata, only the successful full target scheduling journal commit marks consent consumed before Provider invocation; item result commits never consume consent

v1_boundaries.duplicate_hint: identical normalized fact text only; report-only; no merge/delete
v1_boundaries.batch_concurrency_scope: whole Studio process per Provider type
v1_boundaries.fallback: same logical attempt and same attempt_id
v1_boundaries.cache_scope: workspace-level shared payload cache; evidence and result refs are materialized per batch
v1_boundaries.cache_hit_materialization: reuse only validated provider payload; regenerate batch-local evidence IDs, binding_hashes and result_ref
v1_boundaries.owner_rebind: new process instance may claim same workspace owner after restart only when no unexpired lease exists; claim increments manifest.claim_generation and is CAS-protected
v1_boundaries.api_scope: all route request/response/error payloads are schema-bound; expressions and identity/person/family binding remain hard rejected
v1_boundaries.result_stage_binding: item.result_stage identifies the latest committed result; item.active_attempt_stage identifies the in-flight stage; metadata_pending keeps result_stage=facts until the metadata result commits
v1_boundaries.prebatch_promotion: scan/snapshot/unit files live under prebatches/<scan_id> until create atomically promotes them into batches/<batch_id>
v1_boundaries.cache_hit_attempt: cache hit creates attempt_kind=cache_hit plus cache_materialization sidecar; provider_request_id uses cache:<cache_key> and token_usage_known=false
v1_boundaries.consent_issue: raw consent_token is returned once in API response and never persisted; only token_hash is stored
v1_boundaries.promotion_recovery: scan.promotion.operation_id is a projection pointer; promotion_journal.operation_id and promotion_journal.state remain the authoritative recovery mapping and state
v1_boundaries.review_read_api: item-detail returns facts/evidence/source-unit projection; source-unit route returns normalized source text for human review
v1_boundaries.cache_files: cache entry, payload and commit marker are separate files sharing cache_key; the published marker authorizes the hit and all three are atomically committed or quarantined together
v1_boundaries.prebatch_review_route: prebatch-source-unit reads normalized source before promotion
v1_boundaries.consent_cas: start uses consent revision + state=issued CAS; only successful journal commit marks consent consumed
v1_boundaries.stage_attempt: every attempt has stage and result_schema_id matching its result
v1_boundaries.authoring_projection: military maps to war and batch fact kinds map to existing authoring fact kinds before needs_review creation

prebatch_layout.promotion: create atomically persists a workspace reservation with server-owned reservation_id, allocation_id, canonical_input_hash, provider fingerprint, operation_id, claim_generation and owner fence; it durably moves reserved to allocation_pending before the idempotent allocator call, persists one batch_id against allocation_id, writes a prepared promotion journal, CAS-updates reservation to promoting, creates and verifies the temporary batch, atomically renames it, commits the promotion journal, CAS-updates reservation to committed, and only then updates scan.promotion.state as a projection; the same idempotency key and allocation_id never allocate a second batch.
promotion_write_order: persist reservation state=reserved with reservation_id, allocation_id, operation_id, owner_instance_id, fence_token, claim_generation, claim_expires_at and no batch_id
CAS reservation reserved -> allocation_pending before invoking the batch allocator
execute a durable idempotent allocation keyed by allocation_id; persist the resulting batch_id in the same reservation before returning allocation success
durably write promotion journal state=prepared with scan_id,batch_id,operation_id,idempotency_key,reservation_id,claim_generation
CAS reservation to state=promoting with the same batch_id, operation_id, claim_generation and fence_token
create batches/<batch_id>.tmp only after the prepared journal and promoting reservation are durable
advance journal through copying,verified,renamed,committed with flush before each state replacement
CAS reservation from promoting to committed after journal state=committed; keep batch_id permanently
update scan.promotion.state only after journal and reservation are both committed

promotion_crash_windows.before_allocation_pending_cas: reservation remains reserved with no batch_id; same-key retry may resume only after owner fence expiry
promotion_crash_windows.after_allocation_pending_before_batch_id: reservation is allocation_pending with allocation_id and no batch_id; recovery replays the same durable allocation_id and never calls an allocator with a new ID
promotion_crash_windows.after_batch_id_allocation_before_prepare: reservation is allocation_pending with the recorded batch_id; recovery writes the prepared journal from reservation.operation_id and batch_id, then continues or marks needs_reconcile; no second batch is allocated
promotion_crash_windows.after_prepared_before_reservation_cas: recover using reservation.operation_id and prepared journal; CAS reservation to promoting or mark reservation and journal needs_reconcile; never allocate a second batch
promotion_crash_windows.after_reservation_cas_before_temp: mark reservation and journal needs_reconcile; quarantine any discovered temp only by the recorded batch_id
promotion_crash_windows.after_temp_before_rename: verify or quarantine the recorded temp; never infer a target directory
promotion_crash_windows.after_rename_before_journal_commit: verify recorded target, commit journal or quarantine target, then continue reservation commit
promotion_crash_windows.after_journal_commit_before_reservation_: CAS reservation promoting to committed using operation_id, fence and claim_generation; recovery must perform this before updating the scan projection
promotion_crash_windows.after_reservation_commit_before_scan_pro: replay the scan projection from the committed journal and reservation; no new batch is allocated

provider_fingerprint_contract.stability: same resolved provider configuration and adapter revisions produce the same fingerprint across processes and restarts
provider_fingerprint_contract.resolution_failure_behavior: reject create before writing create reservation or allocating batch_id

authoring_projection.projection_validation: projected domain/kind must pass awake.worldbook.authoring.v1 and AuthoringDraftDocumentBuilder before document commit

reserved.retry: resume the same reservation only after the original owner fence expires; never allocate a second batch

allocation_pending.retry: retry the same idempotency key after the advertised delay; recovery replays allocation_id and preserves any recorded batch_id

promoting.retry: retry the same idempotency key after recovery or retry_after_seconds; owner rebind may occur only after claim expiry

committed.retry: return the persisted public manifest for the recorded batch_id

failed.retry: do not allocate another batch with this key; inspect the public error and use a new key only after manual resolution

needs_reconcile.retry: retry the same key after recovery reconciliation; batch_id remains stable

prepared.retry: recover by CAS to promoting or mark needs_reconcile; never allocate again

copying.retry: resume or rebind after claim expiry

verified.retry: resume or rebind after claim expiry

renamed.retry: resume journal commit or rebind after claim expiry

aborted.retry: do not replay automatically; use a new key after manual resolution

quarantined.retry: reconcile quarantine, then retry the same key

needs_reconcile.retry: reconcile, then retry the same key

preconditions: old owner_instance_id and old fence_token match
promotion_claim_rebind.atomicity: reservation CAS and journal binding update are one journaled recovery operation
promotion_claim_rebind.old_fence_behavior: old owner/fence submissions are rejected with WB-BATCH-CLAIM-409
promotion_claim_rebind.batch_id_behavior: preserve the recorded batch_id and never allocate another one

recovery_matrix.journal_prepared: allocation_pending or promoting claim may be repaired by operation_id; preserve batch_id
recovery_matrix.journal_copying: rebind only after claim expiry; resume recorded temp
recovery_matrix.journal_verified: rebind only after claim expiry; resume recorded temp
recovery_matrix.journal_renamed: rebind only after claim expiry; finish commit
recovery_matrix.journal_committed: no rebind; commit reservation CAS then projection
recovery_matrix.journal_quarantined: rebind only through reconciliation operation; reservation needs_reconcile

promotion_contract.journal_authority_note: The generic batch journal state vocabulary and the promotion journal state vocabulary are separate contracts: generic journals use prepared/committed/aborted/quarantined/needs_reconcile; promotion_journal uses prepared/copying/verified/renamed/committed/aborted/quarantined/needs_reconcile.

path_validation.schema_path_validator: all schema-specific workspace paths must also pass the segment validator; no schema may rely on a broader regex

facts_and_metadata_consent_path.transition: CAS item review_status accepted -> status metadata_pending with status_reason metadata_queued and active_attempt_stage=none; preserve result_stage=facts
facts_and_metadata_consent_path.next_entry: start.stage=metadata is allowed only after this CAS commits

facts_only_consent_path.transition: CAS review decision commits accepted facts but leave item status=facts_review and status_reason=facts_accepted_waiting_for_metadata_consent; do not start metadata
facts_only_consent_path.next_entry: a later facts_and_metadata consent and explicit metadata queue CAS are required

metadata_start_preconditions: current accepted_fact_set_hash equals the accepted hash bound by the item
facts_review_to_metadata.metadata_commit: metadata result and item journal commit may move metadata_running -> ready_to_create and result_stage=facts -> metadata; consent was already consumed at the metadata target scheduling journal commit before Provider invocation and must not be consumed again at result commit

metadata_failure.provider_failure: metadata_running -> failed with status_reason metadata_provider_permanent_error or metadata_provider_transient_error; active_attempt_stage=none; result_stage=facts; preserve accepted facts
metadata_failure.unknown_result: metadata_running -> unknown_result with status_reason metadata_network_unknown; active_attempt_stage=none; result_stage=facts; preserve accepted facts
metadata_failure.consent: metadata consent was consumed at target scheduling before Provider invocation; provider failure/unknown_result therefore requires a newly issued consent for the failed retry subset
metadata_failure.retry_entry: retry-item(stage=metadata, manual_confirmation=true) is the only requeue entry; it performs no Provider call and CASes failed/unknown_result -> metadata_pending with status_reason metadata_retry_queued
metadata_failure.retry_start: start(stage=metadata) is the only Provider entry after the requeue and repeats accepted fact set validation

metadata_start.transition: journaled CAS item metadata_pending -> metadata_running, set active_attempt_stage=metadata and lease, then create the metadata attempt; only after this transition may Provider be called
metadata_start.committed_result: metadata_running -> ready_to_create, active_attempt_stage=none, result_stage=metadata; consent was already consumed at target scheduling, and this item result commit does not consume it again
metadata_start.consent: after the full metadata target set CASes to metadata_running and the start-schedule journal commits, CAS the issued consent to consumed before any Provider call

batch_start.scope: start request is batch-level but each invocation carries an explicit target_item_ids set
batch_start.consent_binding: consent.authorized_item_ids is the maximum item scope; target_item_ids must be a non-empty subset and is recorded in the start journal
batch_start.atomicity: all target items must be eligible for the requested stage; if any item fails eligibility or CAS, no target item is transitioned and the request returns a revision/stage error
batch_start.facts_stage: queued or retryable facts items in target set transition atomically to extracting; Provider outcomes later settle per item; facts scope consent is consumed after the scheduling journal commits
batch_start.facts_and_metadata_stage: facts_and_metadata consent remains issued after facts scheduling so accepted items in the authorized scope may later enter metadata
batch_start.metadata_stage: accepted items in target set transition metadata_pending -> metadata_running atomically before Provider calls; metadata scope consent is consumed after this scheduling journal commits
batch_start.partial_provider_outcomes: partial success/failure is represented per item after scheduling. Failed or unknown metadata items require a new consent authorized for the retry target subset; successful items are not rerun

consent_scope_matrix.facts: authorizes only the authorized_item_ids for facts stage; consent is consumed when an atomic facts target selection is scheduled; failed facts items need a new facts consent for retry
consent_scope_matrix.facts_and_metadata: authorizes the authorized_item_ids for facts and later metadata subsets; it remains issued after facts scheduling, and is consumed when an atomic metadata target selection is scheduled
consent_scope_matrix.metadata_retry: retry-item(stage=metadata) may requeue only failed/unknown target items without Provider call; a subsequent start(stage=metadata) requires a newly issued facts_and_metadata consent whose authorized_item_ids cover the retry target subset

order: CAS all target items metadata_pending -> metadata_running
facts_and_metadata_metadata_stage.provider_failure: consent remains consumed; successful items are not rerun; failed/unknown target subset requires a newly issued consent
facts_and_metadata_metadata_stage.provider_success: item result commits independently; consent is already consumed at schedule commit
facts_and_metadata_metadata_stage.partial_schedule_failure: no item transition and no consent consumption
contradictory_phrases_forbidden: consume consent after metadata result commit
